timing: Planned while the sole author job remained running, before reading its new RTL or runner; exact executable probe seams are chosen only after its terminal result.
scope: Synthetic log/process qualification of the new author runner, separate from actual ModelSim functional evidence.
valid_control: The exact real successful author log and actual command record must remain accepted.
must_reject: Successful-looking log with a nonzero actual subprocess exit code
Timeout even when captured output contains the ordinary success marker
Ordinary success marker replaced by an enclosing NOT_<marker>_suffix substring
An additional conflicting or malformed required statistics record
A required statistics record or field removed
A foreign plain or case-varied fatal/error diagnostic
A positive or malformed error tally on an ordinary successful run
Invalid parameter run with an unrelated fatal instead of the exact DUT-owned guard
Exact guard plus a foreign error/fatal or contradictory error accounting
Any selected execution failure hidden by a different selected successful case
constraints: Do not run old suites or alter old runner artifacts.
Do not count synthetic probes as new RTL or vendor runs.
Retain original and repaired outputs if a main-owned repair is necessary after author terminal ownership release.
A qualification that is not applicable to the actual runner structure must be explicitly explained, not silently counted as a pass.
